description: React component implementing an authentication gate with admin role verification, including debug panels, session management, and conditional rendering based on user authentication and role, primarily for admin access control.

methods.name: LoadingGate
methods.description: Displays a loading message and optional debug panel during access verification.

methods.name: Blocked
methods.description: Displays a blocked access message with retry option and debug info.

methods.name: shouldShowDebugPanel
methods.description: Determines if the debug panel should be shown based on environment variables.

methods.name: AdminDebugPanel
methods.description: Renders a debug panel showing current admin auth state for development purposes.

methods.name: RequireAuth
methods.description: Main React component that enforces admin authentication, manages session state, and handles redirects and access control.
